lcec bit OUT TRUE lcec.0.D1.din-0 ==> cycle-start
lcec bit OUT FALSE lcec.0.D1.din-1
lcec float OUT 1.5 lcec.0.G2.analog
lcec s32 OUT 0x0000002A lcec.0.G2.count
iocontrol bit OUT TRUE iocontrol.0.user-enable-out ==> estop-loop
iocontrol bit IN TRUE iocontrol.0.emc-enable-in <== estop-loop
halui bit IN FALSE halui.program.run <== cycle-start
short row
